rules.action: Identify groups of methods that use the same fields and move each group into its own class.
rules.description: At least `min_signals` of the listed size/coupling metrics are over their threshold.
rules.title: God class

rules.action: Introduce a narrower interface for the most common callers, or split responsibilities so fewer classes depend on this one.
rules.description: fan-in + fan-out (distinct internal classes) is over the threshold.
rules.title: High coupling

rules.action: Open the cycle and review the highest-ranked dependency to cut.
rules.description: The class belongs to a cyclic group (strongly connected component) of top-level classes.
rules.title: Cyclic dependency membership

rules.action: Move the dependency behind a service or interface in an allowed layer.
rules.description: A class depends on a class in a layer it may not use according to `layering`.
rules.title: Layer violation

rules.action: Route the call through the existing service that owns this data, if one exists.
rules.description: A presentation class depends directly on data access while the application has a service layer.
rules.title: Controller bypasses the service layer

rules.action: Extract cohesive blocks of the method into well-named private methods or collaborating classes.
rules.description: A method's bytecode size is over the threshold. HotSpot does not JIT-compile methods larger than 8000 bytes of bytecode (HugeMethodLimit).
rules.title: Large method

rules.action: Replace nested conditionals with early returns, polymorphism or lookup tables, and add tests per branch first.
rules.description: Branch instructions + 1 (an approximation of cyclomatic complexity from bytecode) is over the threshold.
rules.title: Complex method

rules.action: Group related dependencies behind a facade or split the class by responsibility.
rules.description: Distinct referenced types (internal and external, excluding java.lang) is over the threshold.
rules.title: Too many dependencies

rules.action: Map the entity to a request/response model at the controller boundary so the database model can change independently.
rules.description: A presentation-layer class uses a persistence entity as a parameter, return type, field or call target.
rules.title: Entity used directly by a controller

rules.action: Move the state into an instance managed by the container, or make it immutable.
rules.description: A non-final static field, or a static final collection that is modified, holds shared mutable state.
rules.title: Mutable static state

rules.action: Replace the call with the documented successor API.
rules.description: The class calls a member marked @Deprecated in the application, or a JDK member listed as deprecated in lifecycle-rules.yaml.
rules.title: Deprecated API usage

rules.action: Follow the migration notes on the Technology lifecycle page.
rules.description: The class uses a technology rated aging (MEDIUM) or end-of-life (HIGH) by the lifecycle rules (WP1).
rules.title: Aging or end-of-life framework usage

rules.description: No span in the selected runtime sessions mapped to this class. Unobserved does not mean unused.
